ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point B is a point on line segment AC, and \(AB = 27cm\), \(BC = \frac{1}{3}AB\). What is the length of line segment \(AC\)?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Solution: According to the given problem, $AB=27\text{cm}$, $BC=\frac{1}{3}AB$,\\
$\therefore BC=9\text{cm}$,\\
$\therefore AC=AB+BC=27+9=\boxed{36}\text{cm}$.
